description: This Java class manages WebSocket clients, including registration, message handling, callback management, and cleanup within the mockserver framework.

classes.name: WebSocketClientRegistry
classes.description: Manages WebSocket client connections, message processing, callback registration, and cleanup within the mockserver framework.

methods.name: WebSocketClientRegistry
methods.description: Constructor initializing registry with configuration and logger.

methods.name: receivedTextWebSocketFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket text frames, deserializes messages, and dispatches to appropriate callbacks.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of registered clients.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a new WebSocket client and sends registration message.

methods.name: unregisterClient
methods.description: Unregisters a client, closes connection, and updates metrics.

methods.name: registerResponseCallbackHandler
methods.description: Registers a response callback for a WebSocket client.

methods.name: unregisterResponseCallbackHandler
methods.description: Removes a response callback for a WebSocket client.

methods.name: registerForwardCallbackHandler
methods.description: Registers a forward request callback for a WebSocket client.

methods.name: sendClientMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a registered WebSocket client, either as a request or response.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears all callbacks and client connections, and resets metrics.
